legs.summary: After defeating Starscourge Radahn, a meteor falls on Limgrave near Fort Haight in Mistwood, creating a crater. Descend through the crater to reach Nokron, Eternal City. The crater is on the east side of the Mistwood, southeast of the Mistwood Ruins grace.

steps.text: After Radahn's defeat, ride to the red-marked crater visible on the Limgrave map, south of Fort Haight East grace. Drop down through the crater's layers — use the rock shelves to descend safely. The Nokron, Eternal City grace is at the bottom.

steps.note: Corpse near the first descent into the underground ruins of Nokron — in the initial collapsed building area.
Corpse in the ruins above the Nokron grace, before descending fully.
Corpse in the underground ruins near the entrance descents — first section.

legs.summary: Navigate the rooftops and elevated streets of Nokron to reach the Mimic Tear boss. Silver Tears — liquid silver enemies that mimic the player's equipment — fill these streets. The Mimic Tear is a mirror of your own character and loadout.

steps.text: From Nokron grace, head east through the elevated ruins. Silver Tear enemies populate the streets — they can transform into larger forms. The Mimic Tear grace is reached after crossing the rooftops and descending to the main city level.

steps.note: Dropped by Nox Hammer-wielder enemies in Nokron's main streets.
Corpse in a building on the main street level of Nokron.
Dropped by a Silver Tear (sphere enemy) in Nokron's main streets — these enemies become humanoid when hit.
Dropped by a Silver Tear enemy on the elevated rooftops section of Nokron.

steps.text: Mimic Tear — a mirror of your own character and equipment. Equip minimal gear / a no-damage weapon before entering the fog gate to make it weaker, then swap back mid-fight. Drops Silver Tear Mask.

steps.note: Dropped by Mimic Tear. Raises Arcane by 8 — useful for bleed/poison builds.
Dropped by the Giant Silver Tear enemy just before the Mimic Tear boss fog gate.

legs.summary: Continue south from the Mimic Tear grace into the Ancestral Woods and then across the rooftops to Night's Sacred Ground. The Fingerslayer Blade is the primary objective — it is in a chest below a chair-crypt in Night's Sacred Ground and is required for Ranni's questline. The Mimic Tear Ashes (behind a Stonesword Key fog wall) are also here.

steps.text: From the Mimic Tear grace, proceed south to the Ancestral Woods grace. From Ancestral Woods, traverse the rooftops heading south-southwest to reach Night's Sacred Ground. There is also a second Hallowhorn Grounds here (Regal Ancestor Spirit boss — different from the Siofra version).

steps.note: Chest in a hidden room off the Ancestral Woods — look for an illusory wall in the building east of the Ancestral Woods grace.
Chest at the top of a tower in Night's Sacred Ground, accessible via the cathedral rooftops.
Chest in Night's Sacred Ground's main building — unlocks Blood and Occult Ash of War infusions.
Chest below the chair-crypt (throne) in Night's Sacred Ground. This is the treasure of Nokron and the key item for Ranni's questline — deliver to Ranni at Ranni's Rise to advance her quest.

missable.note: Must be delivered to Ranni before fighting Astel (Lake of Rot) to progress her quest in the correct order.

steps.note: Chest in Night's Sacred Ground — behind a fog gate that requires a Stonesword Key to open. Most powerful summon in the game; spirit ash that mimics your character.
Dropped by a Night's Cavalry boss patrolling the road in Nokron/Ancestral Woods at night.
Corpse in the Night's Sacred Ground area, near the lower plaza.
Corpse in the upper levels of Night's Sacred Ground.
Corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, upper accessible area.
Corpse on the outskirts of Night's Sacred Ground.
Dropped by a Silver Tear (large sphere) in Night's Sacred Ground or nearby rooftops.
Dropped by the Blackflame Monk Amon (named enemy) in the rooftop area near Night's Sacred Ground.
Corpse in Night's Sacred Ground or the plaza below.
Found in Night's Sacred Ground — a tool that emits a special cry.

steps.text: Return to Ranni's Rise (Liurnia, Three Sisters area) and give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. She gives you the Carian Inverted Statue and enters a long sleep. This unlocks Renna's Rise sending gate to Ainsel River Main.

missable.lockedBy: None — can be delivered at any time before the quest's final stages
missable.note: The Carian Inverted Statue is needed to progress Ranni's quest. After this, Renna's Rise (furthest tower of Three Sisters) becomes accessible.

legs.summary: The Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace connects Nokron to the Siofra River Aqueduct — the path forward to Deeproot Depths. The Valiant Gargoyle duo boss guards the coffin at the aqueduct's end. After defeating them, enter the coffin to be transported to Deeproot Depths (separate region). Also: the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokron is accessible now from the Siofra side via the western waygate.

steps.text: From Night's Sacred Ground, descend toward the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace. This area connects to the lower Siofra River aqueduct. The Dragonkin Soldier of Nokron is now accessible via the Siofra River waygate (enter from the west side of the aqueduct).
Dragonkin Soldier of Nokron — accessed via the western waygate on the Siofra River aqueduct. Drops Dragon Halberd and Gargoyle's Twinblade. This is the same dungeon area as Siofra River.

steps.note: Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier of Nokron.
Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier of Nokron.
Dropped by Valiant Gargoyle (one of the two in the duo fight).

steps.text: Valiant Gargoyle (duo) — two gargoyle bosses at the end of the Siofra Aqueduct. The second appears at around 60% HP of the first. Mimic Tear Ashes is extremely effective here. Dropping the boss count: killing one and then the other unlocks the coffin.

steps.note: Corpse in the Aqueduct area near the gargoyle fight — allows purchasing Ghost Glovewort 1-3 from Twin Maiden Husks.

steps.text: After the Valiant Gargoyles, interact with the coffin at the waterfall edge. This transports you to Deeproot Depths (covered in the Deeproot region). Before entering: confirm the Fingerslayer Blade has been delivered to Ranni, as Ranni's quest in Ainsel/Nokstella/Lake of Rot runs parallel.
